meta_title: Team Greens Tree Services | Arborist Southampton
meta_description: Team Greens Tree Services in Southampton offers expert tree surgery, pruning, felling and stump removal. Professional arborists serving Chandler's Ford and surrounding areas.
hero_eyebrow: Certified Arborists — Safe Tree Work Every Time
hero_subhead: Overgrown branches threatening your property? Our certified arborists remove, prune, and maintain trees safely, leaving your garden transformed.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From routine pruning to emergency storm damage, we handle every aspect of tree care with skill and safety at the heart.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe removal of dead, diseased, or unwanted trees of any size. We dismantle large specimens carefully to protect your property, and haul away all waste.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Shape and thin your trees to improve sunlight, airflow, and appearance. Reduces strain on branches and encourages healthy new growth.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Grind out stubborn stumps below ground level so you can reclaim your garden space. Ideal for planting or paving afterwards.

services.title: Dead Wood Clearance
services.desc: Remove dangerous dead branches and limbs that pose a risk to your family, home, or neighbours. Prevents accidents and disease spread.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Fast response to fallen trees, split limbs, and storm damage. Available 24/7 to make your garden safe again, day or night.

services.title: Tree Health & Aftercare
services.desc: Expert advice on tree preservation, disease treatment, and seasonal maintenance. Keep your trees thriving for decades to come.

about_pullquote: I started Team Greens because I believe every tree deserves proper care, not careless hacking.
about_para_1: Team Greens Tree Services was founded in 2006 by Mark Green, an arborist passionate about preserving Southampton's woodland heritage whilst keeping gardens safe. Over 18 years, we've felled hundreds of trees, pruned thousands more, and earned a reputation for careful, professional work. Every member of our team holds recognised qualifications in tree surgery and safety.
about_para_2: Homeowners and businesses across Southampton and Chandler's Ford trust us because we listen first, explain clearly, and leave your garden cleaner than we found it. We don't rush jobs or upsell unnecessary work. That's why our customers come back, and why they recommend us to their neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Mark and the lads came out to remove a massive oak that was leaning towards the house. The whole job was done in a morning, and they even chipped the branches. Absolutely brilliant — put our minds at ease. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Our cherry tree was full of dead wood and looked a right mess. They pruned it back expertly and explained exactly what they were doing. It's now healthy and looks beautiful again. Fair pricing too.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Called them for emergency work after a storm. They were here within a couple of hours, sorted the fallen branch and made the area safe. Professional, efficient, and didn't try to rob us. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Robert T.
